items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Any questions, Rob? I have one more.

ctx.x: Mm. And a lot of Chopin's music, and Bach and Rachmaninoff, all of that, especially for this dancer, you've got to play all that type of stuff. Mm-hmm.
Any questions, Rob? I have one more. Who were some of the arrangers that wrote for Celestan?

There was a fellow from St. Louis who was very good by the name of Cecil. I can't remember his last name right now, but Cecil was one who was hired especially for arranging. Then there was one named Henry Holloway. Kildee. Kildee. Kildee. He was a member of the band. He was very good as an arranger. And we used to buy arrangements from Fats Pichon.
